subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: MTP Act 2021, Mifepristone, Misoprostol and MVA

steps.tx: The Indian law governing legal termination of pregnancy, amended in twenty twenty one, is the **MTP Act 2021**. It permits termination up to twenty weeks with one doctors opinion and twenty to twenty four weeks for specified categories with two opinions. Beyond that, medical boards decide for fetal anomalies.
steps.say: The MTP Act 2021 permits termination to twenty weeks, and twenty four for specified categories.

steps.tx: The antiprogestogen starting medical abortion by detaching the pregnancy is **mifepristone**. It blocks progesterone, softens the cervix and sensitises the uterus to prostaglandins. A single oral dose begins the two drug regimen. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Mifepristone blocks progesterone to start medical abortion and sensitise the uterus.

steps.tx: The prostaglandin completing expulsion after mifepristone is **misoprostol**. Given buccally, sublingually or vaginally, it contracts the uterus and expels products. Cramping and bleeding heavier than a period are expected. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Misoprostol contracts the uterus to complete expulsion after mifepristone.

steps.tx: Handheld syringe suction evacuation of the uterus is **manual vacuum aspiration**. It needs no electricity and suits primary care settings to twelve weeks. Tissue is inspected afterwards to confirm completeness. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Manual vacuum aspiration evacuates the uterus with a handheld syringe to twelve weeks.

steps.tx: Confidentiality is absolute under the Act, a protection called **privacy provision**. The womans name and details cannot be disclosed except to authorised persons. Even the admission register is a secret document. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Privacy under the MTP Act is absolute and the register itself is a secret document.

steps.tx: Categories eligible from twenty to twenty four weeks include survivors of assault, minors and fetal anomaly cases, listed as **specified categories**. Change of marital status during pregnancy also qualifies under the rules. State level rules operationalise the list. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Specified categories to twenty four weeks include assault survivors, minors and anomalies.

steps.tx: Failure rates of medical abortion rise with gestation, reaching several percent by nine weeks, termed **method failure**. Incomplete abortion is commoner than continuing pregnancy among failures. Surgical evacuation completes management in either case. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Method failure rises with gestation and surgical evacuation completes management.

steps.tx: Pain management and antiemetic cover accompany medical abortion as **supportive care**. Most women manage cramps with simple analgesics and a hot water bottle. Clear written instructions reduce anxiety and unplanned visits. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Supportive care with analgesia and clear instructions accompanies medical abortion.

steps.tx: Contraception counselling immediately after abortion prevents repeat unintended pregnancy, called **post abortion contraception**. Ovulation returns within two to three weeks, before the first period. Long acting methods offered on the same day have the best uptake. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Post abortion contraception matters because ovulation returns within weeks.
